questions.q: In which TV show did Harley Quinn first appear in 1992?
questions.why: She debuted in the Batman: The Animated Series episode 'Joker's Favor', broadcast on September 11, 1992.

questions.q: Which two people created Harley Quinn?
questions.why: Dini wrote and Timm drew her for the animated series before she crossed into comics.

questions.q: What is Harley Quinn's real first name?
questions.why: Her civilian name is Harleen Frances Quinzel; Harley is the nickname she takes as Joker's partner.

questions.q: What was Dr. Quinzel's career before she became Harley Quinn?
options: Newspaper reporter at the Gotham Gazette
questions.why: She worked as a psychiatrist at Arkham Asylum, where she became fixated on one of her patients.

questions.q: Harley's pet hyenas, Bud and Lou, are named after which classic comedy duo?
questions.why: The hyenas were created for the animated series and take their names from Bud Abbott and Lou Costello.

questions.q: Which Gotham rogue is Harley's closest friend and eventual romantic partner in the comics?
questions.why: Ivy was introduced to Harley in a 1993 episode, and the pair's friendship grows into a relationship in the comics.

questions.q: Which 1994 one-shot by the character's creators won both an Eisner and a Harvey award for Best Single Issue?
questions.why: Mad Love, by Dini and Timm, was published in February 1994 and later adapted into an episode of The New Batman Adventures.

questions.q: In the 2020 film Birds of Prey, what is the name of Harley's pet hyena?
questions.why: Margot Robbie's Harley adopts a hyena named Bruce in the film, rather than Bud and Lou.

questions.q: Who voices Harley Quinn in the adult animated series Harley Quinn?
questions.why: Kaley Cuoco voices the lead in the animated series built around Harley and Poison Ivy.

questions.q: Which actress voiced Harley in her 1992 debut, and also inspired the character?
questions.why: Arleen Sorkin voiced Harley in Batman: The Animated Series and was also an inspiration for the character.
